findings.detail: issuer_name for Wash & Wax Holdings LLC leaked the equity class and initial acquisition date even though the source has issuer, investment type, and date in separate columns.
issuer_name for IMB Holdco LLC leaked the industry, Series Z Units security type, and initial acquisition date even though the source has issuer, investment type, and date in separate columns.

rationale: C206 is a real issuer_name extraction defect. The flagged stored values concatenate wrapper/category text plus security type and Initial Acquisition Date into issuer_name. In the raw SOI grid, table 11 row 1 labels separate columns for Portfolio Company, Investment Type, and Initial Acquisition Date; row 13 has Portfolio Company 'Wash & Wax Holdings LLC', Investment Type 'Class A Common Share', and Initial Acquisition Date '4/30/2025'; row 24 has Portfolio Company 'IMB Holdco LLC', Investment Type 'Series Z Units', and Initial Acquisition Date '5/20/2024'. The issuer_name field should contain only the clean portfolio company name.
